item.text: I’m checking epoch-file recovery next. `QuorumPeer.loadDataBase` has a special missing-`acceptedEpoch` upgrade path, but it initializes that missing file from the snapshot epoch rather than the already-present `currentEpoch`; a node with `currentEpoch` ahead of its snapshot may therefore refuse to start.

item.text:
The report now contains eleven reproduced findings at [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/report.md).

This continuation added **F11: a missing `acceptedEpoch` file is initialized below an existing `currentEpoch`, causing startup failure**. In [QuorumPeer.loadDataBase](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/zookeeper-server/src/main/java/org/apache/zookeeper/server/quorum/QuorumPeer.java:1182), the missing-file branch sets `acceptedEpoch = epochOfZxid`, then immediately checks `acceptedEpoch >= currentEpoch`. With a snapshot at zxid 5, `currentEpoch` set to 6, and no `acceptedEpoch` file, the node writes `acceptedEpoch=0` and aborts:

```
java.io.IOException: The accepted epoch, 0 is less than the current epoch, 6
  at org.apache.zookeeper.server.quorum.QuorumPeer.loadDataBase(QuorumPeer.java:1200)
java.lang.RuntimeException: Unable to run quorum server
```

Reproduction: [EpochMissingRepro.java](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/repro/epoch_missing/EpochMissingRepro.java).

The ten earlier findings remain documented: snapshot-fallback state leakage, zero snapshot-size division, non-terminating oracle revalidation, 3+ voter oracle election bypass, digest/lastZxid snapshot incompatibility, data retention on `TRUNC(0)`, runtime-exception fallback failure, empty-tail zxid overstatement, the single-voter reconfiguration exception, and stale `ZKDatabase.clear()` transaction/log-size state. All reproduction files and outputs are under `repro/`; the captured source remains unmodified.
